لك الله من فذ الجلالة أوحد (Laka Allāh min fadhdh al-jalālah awḥad)
Sonnet III: Awhile my hopes will tower aloft in air
Sweet, stay awhile; why will you rise?
Lie down, poor heart, and die awhile for grief
Hope, like the short-liv'd ray that gleams awhile
أوحت لطرفك فاستهل شؤونا (ʼAwḥat li-ṭarfika fa-istahalla shuʼūnan)
